page_title: EVE 0-1 AST | Everton v Aston Villa 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) runs onto a defence-splitting pass and rifles in shot that zooms just over the bar.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Orel Mangala (Everton) jumps into a tackle and Samuel Barrott signals a foul.
86' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
83' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Here comes a substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure is given a rest as he is replaced by Beto (Everton).
83' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Ashley Young will be replaced by Jake O'Brien (Everton).
81' Substitution. Jacob Ramsey did his best and is replaced by Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).
74' Ashley Young (Everton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

73' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Everton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' The Everton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
67' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is caught offside!
65' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
65' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes it short.
64' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Aston Villa have a corner.
62' Ashley Young (Everton) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton). Everton force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' It will be a substitution. Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) is ready to enter the pitch as Jack Harrison walks off.
56' Ashley Young (Everton) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Emiliano Martinez has no trouble gathering it.
54' Jordan Pickford (Everton) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Samuel Barrott's book.
52' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
52' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) commits a foul and Samuel Barrott immediately signals a free kick.
51' 0 - 1 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
49' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) forces a pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
48' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just over the bar.
47' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
43' The corner from Ashley Young (Everton) is hurriedly cleared.
40' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Jordan Pickford makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!

38' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Emiliano Martinez.
37' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and it's Orel Mangala (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
35' The linesman signals that Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
35' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
34' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. It will be a corner kick for Everton.
33' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fails to get a shot on target, as the well positioned defensive wall comfortably deals with his free kick.
32' Ashley Young (Everton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. Aston Villa are awarded a free kick.
30' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' The foul by Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) was seen by Samuel Barrott who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
27' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) runs onto a defence-splitting pass and rifles in shot that zooms just past the right post.
23' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
23' The ball is cleared after Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
21' Aston Villa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
17' Everton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) unleashes a first-time effort from long range, but it's blocked by the defender. The linesman makes the right call and Everton will have a corner.
16' Everton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play and Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
12' The free kick is delivered by Ashley Young (Everton) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
8' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.
8' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
7' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
6' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa), but one of the defenders gets it clear. Aston Villa get a corner.

5' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the inside the right post, but Jordan Pickford earns his money with a fine reflex save. The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.
5' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
4' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. Aston Villa will take a corner kick.
3' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
1' The match has just started.
Everton will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Samuel Barrott.
